id.description: Unique student id (CEPS `ids`, cast to string)

name.description: Deterministic pseudonym generated from id (no LLM)

gesture_examples: Raises a hand to shoulder height and waits
Looks at the teacher and nods
default.expression_strategy: Give the main point, explain briefly, and acknowledge uncertainty.

profile_public.description: Human-readable attributes designed to be directly included in the LLM prompt (no outcome leakage).

prompt_summary.description: One-paragraph English summary of the student for prompting (no teacher-attention outcomes).

latent_traits.description: Numeric traits in [0,1] for simulation internals; keep private from LLM prompt.

raw_ceps.description: Optional raw CEPS codes/values (for auditing). Keep private from prompt.

observed_outcomes.description: Teacher attention outcomes (w2b0504-0509, w2b0603, etc.). Should NOT be included in prompt; generated only if --include_outcomes=1.
